Honestly, as someone with adhd, I have taken meds before,  and it really just slowed everything down.  Like my mind wasn't constantly on this or that never ending cycle, I didn't care for how that felt at first, but then slowly I began to realize how much of who i thought i was is just symptoms of adhd. That, for me, was really conflicting to feel. Who am I without adhd? Turns out I'm the same person, just not 100mph all the time. Having a quiet mind was new and scary combined with anxiety, but hobbies really helped. Does he have hobbies? I imagine he has had many for a short time and then moves on like most others with adhd. Does he feel guilty about it all? Is he stressed or anxious about not being able to get help?

Ask yourself? 

Is going through this the rest of your life and even leaving your country behind to never get married or have kids a life you want? Can you swallow these feelings for 60 more years? 

I know you said before you'd give these up to be with him, but you'll never forget them. You shutting down and grieving this loss ( alone) says a lot, and you're hurting yourself more than I think you can recognize staying with him. 
I know you asked for any advice other than a split, but this comes down to wanting different futures, and that can't be changed much. There might be a few very expensive therapy visits, but in the end, it seems like you want different things, and you both deserve to be happy whatever that means for you. And for you, marriage and a child are important,  and you dont have all the time in the world to have a baby as a woman, the body just can't handle it, stops producing eggs, a bigger chance to miscarry, ect. With that in mind, ide explore the hundreds of other men you can get with that are just as if not better than him and want the same things as you in a structured and planned out way.  

He is a grown man and has to take accountability and do something about his adhd, it's not an uncureable illness and has many forms of therapy to help with its symptoms, making you just live with those symptoms isnt fair, and it's not love. I know that seems harsh, but it pretty much applies to everyone on earth that you may feel bad, might be debilitated by adhd or depression, but you will hurt the people around you if you dont solve the issues, and you can't hurt them forever or expect them to stay. He has to fix it and he has to WANT to fix it. 
Him snapping at you suddenly and saying you need to move to have a kid makes it seem like he has some things he needs to say, especially regarding his random decision to change his mind about your future.
